verdict.rationale: Kommo's documented CRM API includes a batch method that creates leads together with contacts and a company, which covers creating the record and attaching company data. Nothing in the pack shows assigning an owner or responsible user via the API, and there is no evidence of an MCP server. missing for 10: documented owner/responsible-user assignment via API, an MCP server or agent-specific tooling, detailed company field enrichment docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: The method allows you to add leads with contacts and a company to your account in batches.
CRM API is a set of programming tools that allows developers to access client's data and other important information within the CRM and use it to create unique solutions.
